'''Kevin Shannon''' finished 4th at the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] Day 3. His Game 2 modified win vs Steve Brentson is the cut-math example on [[Tournaments]].

This page is a '''fan encyclopedia''' stub. Facts below are from published SWCCG tournament sources. It does not add unsourced biography.
